# Operations Cash Management and Efficiency Review

This document outlines key operational areas requiring attention:

*   Investigate the cash flow based on audit.
*   Optimize the cash flow quarterly.
*   Investigate the branch efficiency for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize the teller performance based on audit.
*   Investigate the customer wait time urgently.
